title: ARM64 pred8V zero-outer-tap six-tap leaf optimization
status: Candidate retained for PR integration; kernel microbench gain is clear for regular filters, while the incremental whole-Pan effect is small and timing-sensitive.

scope.change: For vertical interpolation, regular/smooth filters with k[0]==0 and k[7]==0 use six taps; sharp filters retain the existing eight-tap path.
scope.fixture: Pan benchmark generates deterministic synthetic camera-like content (seed 15, blurred texture, 4-pixel pan steps, constant chroma) in video_bench_test.go; it is not a corpus clip. GOAV1_BENCH_CORPUS_DIR was set but this benchmark does not read it.
scope.claim_limit: The fresh 10-round leaf-vs-VIM6 whole-Pan interval crosses zero. The combined 20 paired rounds favor leaf, but do not imply general codec throughput improvement.

commands.order: Two-way Pan alternated vim6/leaf. Fresh three-way rotated fb5→vim6→leaf, vim6→leaf→fb5, leaf→fb5→vim6. GOMAXPROCS=6 alternated vim6/leaf.

combined_20_pair_leaf_vs_vim6.note: Astra reviewed 20 paired log ratios: 16/20 faster; interval excludes zero. The fresh 10-pair comparison crosses zero.

exploratory_gomaxprocs6.note: Noisy corroboration only: 5/10 faster; one leaf sample reported 171 B/op and 0 allocs/op. Not used for single-thread conclusion.

encoder_parity.skip_note: RealC tests skipped because /tmp/corpus/realC.yuv was unavailable.

reference_decoders.note: Six reference-decoder test cases passed, including P-frame, scaled-reference, monochrome, and lossy reconstruction cases.
